watchdog: Cooperative, includes reset and recording; checked after bounded calls; interruption is not time_limit.

metrics.sim_duration_s: Environment elapsed_sim_s; cross-checked with actual physics steps * dt; excludes settling.
metrics.max_pelvis_height_m: Pelvis body origin above floor: reset handoff and every executed physics substep.
metrics.max_stable_hold_s: Maximum existing SuccessTracker stable_duration_s, never a sum.
metrics.success: Environment is_success and existing tracker recovery_success at terminal transition.
metrics.substeps: Post-integration measurement and tracker at physics_dt. Contact details omitted; support loads retained.
metrics.control: Last substep q/dq/tau_raw are pre-integration at t-dt; actuator torque and post_step state are at t.
metrics.state_hash: qpos float64, qvel float64, observation float32 only, excludes seeds, clocks and paths.
metrics.trajectory_hash: All recorded physical transitions excluding episode, seed and reset_seed; not unrecorded simulator internals.

exception_rule: Stop batch, preserve partial attempt; no replacement episodes. New implementation requires a new full batch.
evaluation_scope: Five registered deterministic attempts, never training or ROS integration validation.
observation_layout: joint position relative to range midpoint / half-range, actuator order
gravity unit vector in pelvis frame
base linear velocity in pelvis frame / saved base_linear_scale_m_s
pelvis height / calibrated h_ref, left/right/other weight fractions
tracker stable duration / hold_s, tracker reference valid
pelvis/left/right drift in pelvis frame / calibrated drift limits
